# signoz_plugin_dashboard (Resource)

Creates a SigNoz **V2** dashboard page layout populated with **WebComponent plugin panels** (`signoz/WebComponentPanel`). Use this to manage Lacrosse plugin host dashboards as code (e.g. `plugin_id = "hello"`, `element = "lax-hello-wc"`).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `title` (String) Dashboard title shown in SigNoz UI.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Dashboard description.
- `page` (Block List) Logical dashboard page / section. At least one page is required. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--page))
- `tags` (List of String) Tags (e.g. lacrosse, plugins).

### Read-Only

- `document` (String) Rendered V2 dashboard JSON document (for inspection).
- `id` (String) Dashboard UUID from SigNoz.

<a id="nestedblock--page"></a>
### Nested Schema for `page`

Required:

- `name` (String) Page name (e.g. Overview, DevTime).

Optional:

- `plugin_panel` (Block List) WebComponent plugin panel on this page. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--page--plugin_panel))

<a id="nestedblock--page--plugin_panel"></a>
### Nested Schema for `page.plugin_panel`

Required:

- `element` (String) Custom element tag (must contain a hyphen), e.g. `lax-hello-wc`.
- `plugin_id` (String) Registered plugin id (Phase 0: `hello`).
- `title` (String)

Optional:

- `attributes` (Map of String) HTML attributes on the custom element.
- `config_keys` (List of String) Config keys this panel instance needs resolved (Phase 2).
- `h` (Number)
- `id` (String) Stable panel id (UUID). Auto-generated at apply time if omitted (not stored as computed state).
- `properties` (String) JSON object of JS properties for the element.
- `w` (Number)
- `x` (Number)
- `y` (Number)
